title: The Country That Dreams in Infinite Strata

features.name: stratum keeper
features.desc-on-touch: a tower of geological time, each layer a dream the earth woke from and then went back to sleep inside; you count the layers and never reach the bottom

features.name: accumulated dream
features.desc-on-touch: sediment-pool where the landscape's sleep collects; you look into it and see every dream the country has forgotten, all at once

features.name: memory layer glyph
features.desc-on-touch: script written in stone that can only be read by pressing your ear to it; you hear the country's voice from seventeen geological ages ago

features.name: depth measurement
features.desc-on-touch: a reading that changes depending on how deep you're willing to imagine; the earth keeps counting in ways humans never invented

features.name: downward passage
features.desc-on-touch: a shaft descending into countries that only exist in dream-time, where the earth's sleep is deeper and stranger

features.name: spiral into knowing
features.desc-on-touch: a stairwell carved into the rock itself, twisting down toward a depth where dreaming stops being metaphor and becomes the only language

inscription: the country dreams in layers; each layer dreams it is the oldest; each layer is right

file.name: EarthDream_Stratal_ArchiveRecord_Continuous.mp3
file.note: continuous recording of geological time-lapse, audio degrading with each deeper layer until only the sound of sleep remains

exits.label: back up to the country where dreaming is still learning geometry
deeper still, toward a bedrock where even the earth forgets what it's dreaming
toward deeper convergence where all the layers meet and become one continuous moment
